notes: Coordinates: all metrics are in font units (divide by unitsPerEm).
codePointRanges: inclusive [first, last] pairs of every code point the file maps to a glyph (cmap); used by the tofu policy.
unsafeCodePoints: code points that have a glyph but must not be written as real PDF text (the font classifies the glyph as a mark, so a browser gives it no advance).
Text must be normalised to NFC before it is measured or drawn; a combining mark that survives NFC is not exportable as text either.
gzipBytes: zlib level 9, for servers that compress font/ttf (many do not by default).

layoutFeatures: every GSUB / GPOS feature tag of the file, over all scripts and language systems. languageSystems: script/language pairs with their own feature set; localisedForms: those among them that carry locl. A browser picks a language system from the lang of the element (or, without one, from its UI language) and the PDF writer never does: the text box pins lang to "en" or "vi", which select none of them.

metrics.inkExtents: how far the ink of Basic Latin, Latin-1 and Vietnamese letters reaches above the baseline, below it, left of the origin and right of the advance (font units). Compare "above" with the ascent the browser uses: anything that clips a text box (overflow, selection frame, thumbnail, raster canvas) must leave that much room.

licences[].copyrightInLicence / copyrightInFonts: the licence texts are the upstream files byte for byte. Where the copyright line of the licence differs from the copyright string inside the font files (Arimo, Great Vibes) that is an upstream inconsistency: do not edit either.
